title: Higher Order Structure along Nilpotent Eigendirections in Planar Vector Fields
summary: We study a distinguished one dimensional restriction associated with planar vector fields whose linearization is a nonzero nilpotent matrix of index two. This restriction admits an intrinsic interpretation on the nilpotent eigendirection, while its scalar representation in Jordan coordinates satisfies a simple transformation law under admissible changes of Jordan chain.
